name: Booking

fields.name: bookingId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the booking

fields.name: vehicleId
fields.description: Reference to the vehicle being parked

fields.name: parkingSpaceId
fields.description: Reference to the assigned parking space

fields.name: startTime
fields.description: Booking start date and time

fields.name: endTime
fields.description: Booking end date and time

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current booking status: confirmed, active, completed, cancelled

fields.name: bookingType
fields.description: Type of booking: advance or walk-in

fields.name: paymentId
fields.description: Reference to associated payment transaction

constraints.endTimeAfterStartTime: endTime must be greater than startTime

description: Manages parking reservations and real-time space allocations with time slots, duration, and booking status

relationships.description: Each booking is associated with one vehicle
Each booking is assigned to one parking space
Each booking may have one associated payment

name: ParkingSpace

fields.name: spaceId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the parking space (e.g., A-101, B-205)

fields.name: spaceType
fields.description: Type of parking space: regular, handicap, VIP, electric, compact

fields.name: isOccupied
fields.description: Current occupancy status of the parking space

fields.name: locationZone
fields.description: Zone or floor identifier within the facility (e.g., Level-1, Zone-A)

fields.name: hourlyRate
fields.description: Hourly parking rate in currency units for this space

fields.name: isAvailable
fields.description: Indicates if space is available for booking (false if under maintenance or reserved)

description: Defines the structure for individual parking spots including location, type, occupancy status, and pricing information

name: Payment

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Transaction amount in the base currency

fields.name: paymentMethod
fields.description: Method of payment (credit_card, debit_card, cash, mobile_wallet, bank_transfer)

fields.name: paymentType
fields.description: Type of payment (booking, permit, penalty, subscription)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Payment status (pending, completed, failed, refunded)

fields.name: transactionDate
fields.description: Timestamp when the payment transaction occurred

fields.name: referenceId
fields.description: External reference ID linking to booking, permit, or penalty record

fields.name: receiptNumber
fields.description: Unique receipt number generated for the transaction

indexes.description: Optimize queries filtering by transaction date
Optimize queries filtering by payment status

constraints.status: Must be one of: pending, completed, failed, refunded
constraints.paymentType: Must be one of: booking, permit, penalty, subscription
constraints.paymentMethod: Must be one of: credit_card, debit_card, cash, mobile_wallet, bank_transfer

description: Records all financial transactions related to parking services including bookings, permits, and penalties

relationships.description: Links payment to the vehicle associated with the transaction
Links payment to the parking space when applicable

name: Permit

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the permit

fields.name: permitType
fields.description: Type of permit (monthly, annual, employee, visitor)

fields.name: vehicleId
fields.description: Reference to the assigned vehicle

fields.name: parkingSpaceId
fields.description: Reference to the assigned parking space (if applicable)

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Permit validity start date

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: Permit validity end date

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current permit status (active, expired, suspended, cancelled)

fields.name: paymentId
fields.description: Reference to the payment transaction for this permit

description: Manages long-term parking permits and subscription-based access with validity periods, permit types, and renewal tracking

relationships.description: Each permit is assigned to one vehicle
Permit may be assigned to a specific parking space
Permit is linked to a payment transaction

name: Vehicle

fields.name: vehicleId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the vehicle record

fields.name: licensePlate
fields.description: Vehicle license plate number for identification

fields.name: vehicleType
fields.description: Type of vehicle (e.g., car, motorcycle, truck, SUV)

fields.name: makeModel
fields.description: Vehicle manufacturer and model information

fields.name: ownerName
fields.description: Full name of the vehicle owner

fields.name: ownerContact
fields.description: Owner's phone number or email for communication

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to associated customer account

fields.name: registrationDate
fields.description: Date when vehicle was registered in the system

indexes.description: Ensures unique license plates and fast lookup

constraints.contactFormat: Owner contact must be valid phone or email format
constraints.validVehicleType: Vehicle type must be from predefined list (car, motorcycle, truck, SUV, van)
constraints.uniqueLicensePlate: License plate must be unique across all vehicles

description: Stores vehicle registration information and ownership details for parking management and tracking purposes

relationships.description: Vehicle can have multiple parking bookings
Vehicle can have multiple entry/exit records
